gloss: big man; large man; giant of a man

definitions.gloss: big man; large man; giant of a man
definitions.explanation: A man who is conspicuously large in stature — tall and/or heavily built. Can describe someone admiringly or neutrally.

examples.japanese: {大男|おおおとこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A big man was standing there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{身長|しんちょう}→身長：03263_shinchou⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大男|おおおとこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧きた。
examples.english: A two-meter-tall giant of a man walked in.

examples.japanese: プロレスラー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような{大男|おおおとこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塞|ふさ}がれて→塞ぐ：00046_fusagu⟧、⟦{動|うご}けなかった→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: A huge man like a pro wrestler blocked the way, and I couldn't move.

notes:
A straightforward compound of {大|おお} (big) + ⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧ (man). Used descriptively without strong positive or negative connotation. Common in storytelling, news descriptions, and everyday conversation when describing someone's imposing physical size.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大男|おおおとこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧: a big man appears
- ⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{大男|おおおとこ}: a well-built big man
- ⟦{見上|みあ}げる→見上げる：04567_miageru⟧ような{大男|おおおとこ}: a man so big you have to look up

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {巨漢|きょかん}: giant man — more emphatic, often used in martial arts or sports
- ⟦{大柄|おおがら}→大柄：17177_oogara⟧: large build — describes body frame, can be used for women too
- {小男|こおとこ}: small man — the opposite
